projects.shortDescription: One-stop collection of standalone bash scripts: Fedora system provisioning, portable Podman managers for n8n & Hermes, and a distro-agnostic GNOME theme pack installer.

paragraphs: A one-stop collection of standalone bash scripts to get a machine productive fast:
Every script is self-contained; nothing is imported or shared between them.
